title: Learning Discrete Decisions for MIPs with Constraint-Aware Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.13079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel learning-based approach to approximately solve instances of mixed-integer optimization problems. These problems are computationally challenging, as they require jointly determining discrete and continuous decisions while satisfying complex combinatorial constraints. The proposed method relies on a graph-based generative diffusion model that learns the discrete component of mixed-integer optimization problems while integrating a training-free feasibility projection operator directly into the reverse diffusion process to steer intermediate samples toward the feasible set throughout generation. Once the discrete decisions are generated, the remaining optimization reduces to a continuous problem that can be solved efficiently (relative to the original problem) using existing numerical methods. translated_title: 面向混合整数规划问题的约束感知扩散学习离散决策
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13079v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文提出了一种新颖的基于学习的方法，用于近似求解混合整数优化问题实例。这些问题在计算上具有挑战性，因为它们需要同时确定离散和连续决策，同时满足复杂的组合约束。所提出的方法依赖于一个基于图的生成扩散模型，该模型学习混合整数优化问题的离散部分，并将一个无需训练的可行性投影算子直接集成到反向扩散过程中，以在生成过程中将中间样本引导向可行集。一旦离散决策生成，剩余的优化问题就简化为一个连续问题，可以使用现有的数值方法高效求解（相对于原始问题）。由此产生的框架名为约束图扩散（CGD），它不依赖于特定问题，可以适应广泛的类别。
tldr: 本文提出一种约束感知的图扩散模型（CGD），通过将可行性投影集成到扩散生成过程中，高效学习混合整数优化问题的离散决策，从而简化求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constraint-aware graph diffusion model (CGD) that integrates feasibility projection into the reverse diffusion process to efficiently learn discrete decisions for mixed-integer optimization problems, simplifying their solution.
